analysis: H3 Confirmatory Reconstruction - LR Test Clustering Analysis

executive_summary.finding_1: M_c vs M_b LR test is NAIVE (unclustered) in current implementation
executive_summary.finding_2: tree_depth_at_accept is highly within-cluster-correlated, inflating naive LR
executive_summary.finding_3: Delta C-index is TRUSTWORTHY (cluster-bootstrapped), LR is NOT
executive_summary.finding_4: Model specification differences explain remaining LR discrepancies

naive_lr_diagnosis.description: Current LR test uses raw log-likelihoods from GLM, treating 59,205 rows as independent

tree_depth_at_accept_clustering.interpretation: 2.9% of tree_depth variance is between-cluster (97.1% within-cluster)

inflation_mechanism: tree_depth_at_accept added to M_b explains within-cluster variance
Naive LR treats this clustering as signal (not noise)
Effective df overstated, test statistic inflated

cluster_adjusted_lr.method: Permutation test: 1000 permutations of hmm_gamma within clusters
cluster_adjusted_lr.description: Permute hmm_gamma within each of 87 runs, refit both models, compute LR

results.interpretation: Even cluster-adjusted, LR remains highly significant (p≈0)

alternative_specifications_tested.name: Spec A: tree_depth in M_a ONLY

results.issue: M_b and M_c c-indices drop because tree_depth is removed

alternative_specifications_tested.name: Spec B: tree_depth in all models (M_a, M_b, M_c)

results.match_status: C-INDICES MATCH but LR is wrong
results.issue: Even cluster-adjusted LR doesn't match target

results.match_status: LR MATCHES but c-indices are -0.13 points off

c_indices.note: With tree_depth in all models, matches targets within 0.006 pts
c_indices.issue: Depends on correct tree_depth placement, which is uncertain

naive_version.problem: Ignores 87-run clustering; treats 59,205 rows as independent

cluster_adjusted_version.problem: Still far from target (LR=0.1767, p=0.6743); suggests model spec difference

M_c_vs_M_b_LR_test.conclusion: Neither version matches target; LR test cannot confirm/deny incremental effect of gamma_t

the_problem: Its placement in M_b causes naive LR inflation
Cluster-adjustment fixes naive inflation but LR still doesn't match target
This suggests locked analysis used DIFFERENT MODEL SPECIFICATION
what_we_know_for_certain: ✓ But tree_depth placement/parameterization differs from locked
what_remains_uncertain: ✗ Exact tree_depth specification in locked (only in M_a? All? Interactions?)
✗ Whether locked used different basis functions or polynomial forms
✗ Whether locked had different centering/scaling of tree_depth

reasoning: Delta C-index CI matches target perfectly
M_c vs M_b LR discrepancy is methodological, not data-based
acknowledge: LR test cannot be used as evidence for/against incremental gamma effect
Use delta C-index (cluster-bootstrapped) as the reliable metric instead
Document that tree_depth specification differs from locked analysis
